title: Renderer: group children invisible in outline mode
description: In packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts lines 1526-1536, the 'group' case in outline mode saves context, sets globalAlpha to 0.4, then restores — but makes no render calls inside. Grouped objects are completely invisible when their layer has outlineMode: true. Fix: in the group case for outline mode, iterate the group's children and render each one with the outline color (same as how non-grouped objects are rendered in outline mode).
